messages:
sarah: heads-up — ColoX just reported a power circuit fault in us-west2 racks. They expect ~40% of scheduled GPU slots to be offline for the next 12-24h. We have 8 reserved A100 slots in that rack for dedicated-pool-redwood-prod. can someone confirm if any scheduled jobs will hit this? cc @mike @jordan

mike: saw the alert, thanks. which SKU specifically? our nightly model-sweep starts in ~2h and touches many A100 nodes.

coloX-bot: ColoX incident CX-2157 — power circuit degraded — affected: us-west2-rack-7 — ETA 18-24h — status page: https://status.colox.example/incidents/CX-2157

jordan: it's A100 80GB in that rack. both the nightly sweep and a canary loadtest are targeting that pool. i'd prefer to shift the sweep to eu-west1 for tonight if possible.

tess: can we get a quick temporary quota bump in eu-west1 to absorb the sweep? also who signs off on an emergency cross-region allocation for cost? @alice?

alice: i can approve up to $2k for urgent capacity. if we estimate below that, i can sign off now. otherwise finance needs to weigh in. how many vGPU-hours are we talking?

jordan: estimate ~120 vGPU-hours for the sweep. should be under $2k but pending exact rate. @mike can you reroute the sweep or produce a fallback plan?

mike: yes, i'll patch orchestration to prefer eu-west1 and create a temp allocation. pushing a terraform change — PR coming. quick snippet of the temp allocation I'm adding:
```terraform
resource "redwood_pool_allocation" "sweep_temp" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  count  = 4
  sku    = "a100-80gb"
  note   = "temp for ColoX outage"
}
```
I'll also add a console quota request to cloud support.

sarah: thanks — @jordan please pause the loadtest if the reroute isn't in place within 30m. i'll open a procurement ticket to ask ColoX for a preferred tenant failover and to push for expedited fix. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-998

coloX-bot: UPDATE — replacement PSU installed on 2 racks; remaining impact reduced to 2 racks. adjusted ETA 8h.

tess: :thumbsup: filing a quota spike request for eu-west1 (+4 GPUs temporary). can someone add billing center BC-3321 to the request so it gets routed correctly?

alice: added BC-3321 to the console request. also please tag the PR with emergency-alloc so finance and SRE can find it quickly.

mike: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/4321 — includes canary routing and temp allocation. planning to apply in 5m unless someone objects.

jordan: no objections. i'll update the runbook (failover section) and cancel the local nightly sweep if we still see problems after reroute.

sarah: action items recap: mike -> apply PR #4321, tess -> file quota request w/ BC-3321, alice -> cost approved (confirmed), jordan -> update runbook + pause if needed, sarah -> monitor ColoX ticket and post in #incidents if ETA changes. :eyes:

sarah: update (8h later): ColoX fixed the remaining PSU issue; us-west2 racks are back to normal. i cancelled the temp allocation and closed INFRA-998. thanks everyone for the quick handoff. :party:
